reasons: Claimed status is 'compliant', and for a protective rule (limiting Vendor audit rights against us) genuine silence in the Agreement leaves the Customer better off than the preferred position, so no redline or counterparty comment is the correct output.

The cited paragraphs support the compliance conclusion: p0001 imposes only a service-delivery cooperation/access covenant (not an audit, inspection or usage-verification right, and no direct or remote access to Customer systems), and p0023 sets out revenue-share and sequential-liability payment mechanics with no verification right or audit cost-shifting on Customer.

The failed deterministic check ('audit frequency limited') is expected and non-probative here, since no audit clause exists to carry frequency/notice/cost parameters; inserting one would create a Vendor audit right that does not currently exist.

Rationale correctly flags the residual watch-item (hold any future Kubient audit proposal to once per 12 months / 30 days' notice / independent auditor / Vendor cost, and strike system-access language) without proposing an unnecessary edit.
